projects.title: Gamer Journey
projects.description:
• Developed a web application for video game players to track their gaming habits and preferences across all platforms. 
• Users can set up a profile to review video games that they have played, track which video games they want to play in the future, and/or get recommendations on what video games they should play next based on previous preferences.  
• The web application utilizes a free API and was developed using the Python Django framework. 
• Deployed web application on AWS leveraging Terraform for infrastructure provisioning: https://gamer-journey.com/

projects.title: Gonzo Card Games
projects.description:
• Simple Python library to create virtualizations of card games with a standard 52 card deck(s)
• Full coverage unit testing with Pytest
• Github Continuous Integration workflow for automated quality assurance of pull requests 
• Documentation generated with Sphinx and hosted on Github Pages 
• Docker image setup to run card games program
